# INPUT_DOC_CITATION_ROUTING — every INPUT DOCUMENT the published L-docs
# cite as their evidence, and whether a reader of this tree can follow it
# (vibe-ic#456). Generated by phase1_parity_source_tier_check.py.
#
#   <protocol> :: <cited path> <DECISION> <detail>
#
# WITHHELD_ON_RECORD is the one that needed a name. An L-doc cites the
# document it was extracted FROM; the extractor held that document, so the
# pointer was true when written. Publication is where it goes stale: the
# input documents are subject to removal for licensing reasons (the reason
# source_tier.json exists and carries a durability_note saying so). The
# pointer was then published unchanged, so a reader following it finds
# nothing and is told nothing.
#
# This does NOT say the value is unverifiable. source_tier.json names the
# document, its tier, and the title/page-count that identifies it, so a
# reader can obtain the document themselves. Unfollowable HERE, obtainable
# THERE — which is a different fact from a pointer nobody can resolve at
# all, and the whole reason the two get separate names.
#
# ABSENT_* are the states that are somebody's bug: a cited document that
# the record does not account for. If a document was ever DROPPED rather
# than withheld, it lands there and stays loud — which is what keeps this
# repair from freezing a fixable gap as 'inherently unfollowable'.
#
# Emitted even when every citation resolves: a record that only appears on
# failure cannot be used to prove there were none.
